summary: Lower a private instance method to a C# private method when all receivers are statically branded and method values do not escape.

target.notes: Emit a C# private instance method and rewrite statically proven `this.#m(...)` or same-brand calls directly.

semantics.prototype_location: private method is installed as a private element, not an ordinary public prototype property

caveats: Private methods share the same brand constraints as private fields.

tests.name: private method direct call
tests.input: class C { #m(){return 2;} run(){return this.#m();} } console.log(new C().run());

tests.name: edge: generic receiver needs brand check
tests.input: class C { #m(){return 2;} static run(o){return o.#m();} } C.run({});
tests.expected_behavior: throws TypeError; native direct call is not permitted when o is not statically branded
